items.text: Seahawks QB Drew Lock has been battling severe tendinitis in his throwing elbow. But he looked good in limited practice reps and will start Sunday against Arizona in place of injured Sam Darnold, with free agency looming in March.
items.why: Injured (quad reported earlier); Lock takes over with his own elbow tendinitis.
items.implication: Bench Sam Darnold; Seahawks offense with backup QB, impact on JSN and other SEA skill.
items.opportunity: Monitor Lock's health and any further QB news; potential volume shifts.
corroboration: Earlier reports of Darnold ruled out with quad
